purpose: Independent practice of E1.2 — building 3D structures and finding 2D shapes inside.
student_learning_goal: I can build a 3D structure and find 2D shapes inside it.

header.student_learning_goal_banner: I can build a 3D structure and find 2D shapes inside it.
header.character_watermark: Trekker Tig in the top-right corner with paper blocks. Small (~1.5in tall). References blueprint.recurring_characters.

parts.student_instructions: Look at each 3D structure. Count and name the 2D shapes you can see.
parts.visual_layout: Three structure illustrations stacked vertically. Each has a blank line below for shape names and counts.

image_placeholders.description: Three 3D structure illustrations for a Grade 1 worksheet, B&W line art with light shading. Structure 1: a tower of 3 cubes (so 3 squares visible front-on). Structure 2: a cube with a pyramid on top — 'cabin' shape (squares on cube + triangles on pyramid). Structure 3: a cylinder + 2 cubes 'bridge' (rectangles + squares + circles). Below each structure, blank lines for the child to write shape names and counts.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image WS02_P1_STRUCTURES at Part 1: instructions ask the child to find shapes in 3D structures. Keywords name the visual elements.

parts.answer_key: Structure 1: squares (multiple). Structure 2: squares + triangles. Structure 3: rectangles + squares + circles.

parts.part_title: Part 2: Build a tower in your mind.
parts.student_instructions: Imagine a tower of 4 cubes. Draw it. List the shapes you see.
parts.visual_layout: Top half: blank drawing space (~4in × 3in). Bottom half: a list area with 5 numbered lines for shapes.

image_placeholders.description: A blank drawing space and shape list for a Grade 1 worksheet, B&W line art. Top: a ~4in × 3in blank rectangle with thin solid border for the child to draw a 4-cube tower. Bottom: 5 numbered list lines for shape names.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image WS02_P2_TOWER at Part 2: instructions ask the child to draw a tower. Keywords name the structure type.

parts.answer_key: Drawing of 4 stacked cubes. Shape list: squares (visible per face). Strong answers note multiple squares per cube.

parts.student_instructions: Build (or draw) any structure. Find 3+ different 2D shapes inside.
parts.visual_layout: Large blank drawing space (~5in × 4in) with a list area below for shape names.

image_placeholders.description: A large blank drawing space for a Grade 1 worksheet, ~5in × 4in with thin solid border, plus a small list area below with 4 lines for shape names. Designed for the child's own structure design.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image WS02_P3_FREE at Part 3: instructions ask the child to build any structure. Keywords name the activity.

parts.answer_key: Any structure with at least 3 different 2D shapes named.

early_finisher_prompt: If you finish, build a structure with all 5 different 3D shapes.
teacher_notes: Lesson 2 consolidation artifact. Use Part 1 as the formative signal for 'turn and find' — children who count shapes from multiple faces have grasped the rule.
